Meta-model learns optimal weights from validation windows, adapting to the unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality structure better than fixed heuristics

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8925.
